tasks.query: refresh API v3 retry policy attempts rate limit
tasks.prompt: Implement shouldRetry(status, attempt) in policy.mjs for the current refresh API v3. attempt is the number of retries already performed. Preserve the exported function signature.
tasks.starter: export function shouldRetry(status, attempt) { return true; }

memories.content: Refresh API v3 retry policy: retry HTTP 429 while attempt is less than 2; never retry HTTP 401 or other statuses
Refresh API v2 retry policy: retry HTTP 401 while attempt is less than 4
Billing webhook idempotency keys use the invoice event ID
